About these 56 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Sunday has the most, with 21. The earliest start is Berkeley Bicycle Club Friday Coffee Ride at 6:50 am; the latest is San Jose Bike Party at 8:00 pm. After work, 15 roll on a weekday evening. Beginners are welcome on 17 of them. There are 2 rides made for LGBTQ+ riders, 6 for women, trans and femme riders, 1 for BIPOC riders and 4 for families. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Nov 9, 2026.
